reference_use.conclusion: The project and Mathlib revisions match the manifest; the project contract files match the snapshot byte-for-byte, and the pinned dependency worktrees are clean. All seven exact one-line propositions passed the statement validator and independently elaborated in verifier-generated challenge modules against a fresh frozen Submission build, without child implementations. Every proposed name is a bare identifier, is absent from the snapshot, and conflicts with no other DAG declaration. No accepted declaration is reused. Imported uniqueness, differentiation, Hausdorff-image and inverse-continuity results have only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound as axioms. Separate Lean checks confirm that continuous-linear-endomorphism multiplication is composition and that the required inverse-continuity instance exists. The split is appropriate: the supplied assembly uses affine transport, weighted tangency and uniqueness to obtain the exact projection identity, then projection continuity to obtain a.e. strong measurability. Its only sibling dependencies are weighted_tangent_ae on lebesgue_point_growth and weighted_tangent_pointwise, with no cycle. Historical branch-status and budget claims were not relied upon: several related declarations are now accepted with different types, and the inspected configuration sets max_nodes to 1000.

nodes.reason: The prose and Lean type agree. Injectivity supplies dimension n; the localized bi-Lipschitz measure comparison, explicitly established integrability and uniform continuity prove the required test-integral convergence without an area formula or circular reliance.

Translation cancels in the blow-up identity. Isometric change of variables and compactly supported test-function pullback prove exactly the mapped-plane conclusion, including its dimension, without additional measurability assumptions on S.

Compact containment supplies the derivative and Lipschitz bounds. The radius-2r parameter-ball argument and normalized Hausdorff image estimate establish the stated uniform bound for every center and positive radius, including the empty-intersection case.

Growth supplies local finiteness and the Besicovitch hypotheses. Differentiation and the ENNReal comparison prove the exact limit; zero-mass balls and the possibility of nonpositive C are correctly handled.

Scaling and localization use the stated null-measurability hypotheses correctly. The Lebesgue-limit assumption establishes integrability before subtraction of integrals, and the resulting error estimate proves exactly the weighted tangent predicate.

Both dependencies are correctly directed. Indicator integrability, transfer of the differentiation exceptional set and pointwise inheritance establish the a.e. conclusion simultaneously for every P. No measurability of S is silently assumed.

The explicit adjoint construction yields invertible A#A and the orthogonal projection formula. The independently checked endomorphism ring uses composition; inverse continuity and conjugation prove the exact ContinuousOn statement, including n = 0.
